blocks.text: **Frazali fe'l** (phrasal verb) — fe'l va kichik so'z (up, down, on, off, in, out, away, back, over) birikmasi. Ikkalasi birga ko'pincha **yangi ma'no** beradi va uni alohida so'zlardan topib bo'lmaydi: give («bermoq») + up → **give up** — «taslim bo'lmoq, tashlamoq»; take («olmoq») + off → **take off** — «(samolyot) havoga ko'tarilmoq». O'zbek tilida shunga o'xshash hodisa — ko'makchi fe'llar: yiqilib **tushmoq**, chiqib **ketmoq**, yozib **olmoq**. Ikkinchi qism ma'noni o'zgartiradi yoki aniqlashtiradi; inglizchada bu vazifani fe'ldan keyingi kichik so'z bajaradi.

Frazali fe'llar so'zlashuvda juda ko'p ishlatiladi; ularning rasmiy sinonimlari ham bor: carry on = continue, find out = discover, call off = cancel. Ba'zilari **to'ldiruvchisiz** keladi: The plane **took off**. Our car **broke down**. Ba'zilari to'ldiruvchi oladi: **put on** your coat. Ba'zilari ikkala holatda: I **woke up** (uyg'ondim) / **Wake** me **up** (meni uyg'ot). Bu darsda asosan to'ldiruvchisiz va uch qismli (run out **of**, get on **with**) fe'llar; to'ldiruvchi va olmoshning o'rni — 122-darsda.

rows: get up, stand up, grow up; eat up, use up
sit down, lie down; slow down, calm down
carry on, go on, hold on; get on the bus
take off, set off, get off, go off
come in, get in, check in
go out, get out, eat out; run out, the lights went out
come back, go back, get back
fall over, turn round, come round

blocks.text: Kichik so'zning ma'nosi taxmin qilishga yordam beradi, lekin har doim emas. Bitta frazali fe'l bir necha ma'noga ega bo'lishi mumkin: **go off** — signal chalinmoq (the alarm went off), ovqat buzilmoq (the milk has gone off), portlamoq. Shuning uchun ularni yolg'iz emas, qisqa ibora bilan yodlang: «the plane took off», «we ran out of time».

items.text: The plane **took off** an hour late because of the fog.
items.translation: Tuman tufayli samolyot bir soat kech **havoga ko'tarildi**.

items.text: **Get off** at the third stop, near the museum.
We **set off** for Khiva before sunrise.

rows: sport bilan shug'ullanmoq; yaxshi hal bo'lmoq

items.text: Please **carry on** — I didn't mean to interrupt.
How did you **find out** about the job?
We **ran out of** petrol on the way to Samarkand.
The fire alarm **went off** in the middle of the night.
I **grew up** in a small village near Fergana.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: so'zma-so'z tarjima — **give up** «yuqoriga bermoq» emas, «taslim bo'lmoq / tashlamoq»; kichik so'zni tushirib qoldirish — «The plane took at nine.» → The plane **took off**; «I grew in Bukhara.» → I **grew up**; «We've run out milk.» → **run out of** milk (`of` shart); noto'g'ri kichik so'z — «get out the bus» → **get off** the bus (avtobus, poyezd, samolyot — **on / off**; mashina, taksi — **in / out**); «I'm looking forward to see you.» → to **seeing** you (bu yerda **to** — predlog, keyin `-ing`).

Zamonni frazali fe'lning **fe'l qismi** ko'rsatadi, kichik so'z hech qachon o'zgarmaydi: get up → **got** up → has **got** up; take off → **took** off; grow up → **grew** up. Bog'liq darslar: → 114-dars (go in, fall off, run away), 115-dars (put on your shoes / put them on), 122-dars (to'ldiruvchili frazali fe'llar), 117-dars (noto'g'ri fe'llar).

items: Frazali fe'l = fe'l + kichik so'z (up, down, on, off, in, out, away, back, over); ma'nosi ko'pincha yangi.
Zamon fe'l qismida o'zgaradi: woke up, has set off, will get back; kichik so'z doim bir xil.
Bu darsdagilarning ko'pi to'ldiruvchisiz: the plane took off, my car broke down.
Uch qismlilarda (run out **of**, get on **with**, look forward **to**) predlogdan keyin ot, olmosh yoki `-ing` keladi.
Bir fe'l bir necha ma'noli bo'lishi mumkin (take off, go off, work out) — iborani kontekst bilan yodlang.

examples.title: Daily life: **wake up**, **get up**, **stay up**
examples.description: Kundalik hayotdagi to'ldiruvchisiz frazali fe'llar: wake up, get up, stay up, go out, eat out, come round, lie down, sit down, stand up, come back.

sentences.text: I usually **wake up** before my alarm goes off.
sentences.translation: Odatda budilnik chalinmasdan oldin **uyg'onaman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **got up** late and missed his first lesson.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kech **turdi** va birinchi darsga ulgurmadi.

sentences.text: On Saturday night we **stayed up** until three watching films.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni kechasi soat uchgacha film ko'rib **uxlamay o'tirdik**.

sentences.text: Do you want to **go out** tonight, or shall we stay in?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ko'chaga chiqamizmi** yoki uyda qolamizmi?

sentences.text: Madina and her husband **eat out** every Friday evening.
sentences.translation: Madina eri bilan har juma oqshomi **restoranda ovqatlanadi**.

sentences.text: Why don't you **come round** for tea after work?
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin choyga **kelmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Dad came home tired and **lay down** on the sofa.
sentences.translation: Dadam uyga charchab keldi va divanga **yonboshladi**.

sentences.text: When the teacher walked in, all the students **stood up**.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirganda barcha o'quvchilar o'rnidan **turishdi**.

sentences.text: Please **sit down** and make yourself comfortable.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **o'tiring**, o'zingizni uydagidek his qiling.

sentences.text: My grandparents **came back** from their trip to Bukhara last week.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim o'tgan hafta Buxoro safaridan **qaytib kelishdi**.

examples.title: Travel: **set off**, **take off**, **get off**
examples.description: Sayohat va transport: set off, take off, get on / get off (avtobus, poyezd), get in (mashina), check in, break down, go away, slow down, get back.

sentences.text: My grandparents **set off** for Samarkand before sunrise to beat the heat.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim jaziramaga qolmaslik uchun quyosh chiqmasdan Samarqandga **yo'lga chiqishdi**.

sentences.text: Our plane **took off** on time and landed in London at noon.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz o'z vaqtida **havoga ko'tarildi** va tushda Londonga qo'ndi.

sentences.text: Which stop do I **get off** at for the Registan?
sentences.translation: Registon uchun qaysi bekatda **tushaman**?

sentences.text: Hurry up and **get in** — the taxi is waiting!
sentences.translation: Tezroq **o'tir** — taksi kutib turibdi!

sentences.text: You can **check in** at the hotel after two o'clock.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada soat ikkidan keyin **ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: Halfway to Bukhara, our old car **broke down**.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga yarim yo'lda eski mashinamiz **buzilib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Are you **going away** this summer?
sentences.translation: Bu yoz dam olishga **ketasizmi**?

sentences.text: The driver **slowed down** because the road was icy.
sentences.translation: Yo'l muz bo'lgani uchun haydovchi **tezlikni pasaytirdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **got on** the wrong train and ended up in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Sara adashib boshqa poyezdga **chiqib qoldi** va Manchesterga borib qoldi.

sentences.text: What time did you **get back** from the airport last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun aeroportdan soat nechada **qaytib keldingiz**?

examples.title: Going on and stopping: **carry on**, **give up**
examples.description: Davom etish va to'xtash: carry on, go on, keep on, give up, fall behind, keep up, catch up with, drop out.

sentences.text: **Carry on**, Madina — your story is really interesting.
sentences.translation: **Davom et**, Madina — hikoyang juda qiziq.

sentences.text: The meeting **went on** for three hours, and everyone was tired.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish uch soat **davom etdi**, hamma charchadi.

sentences.text: My father **gave up** smoking when I was born.
sentences.translation: Men tug'ilganimda dadam chekishni **tashlagan**.

sentences.text: Don't **give up** — you'll pass the exam next time!
sentences.translation: **Taslim bo'lma** — keyingi safar imtihondan o'tasan!

sentences.text: Aziz was ill for two weeks, so he **fell behind** with his studies.
sentences.translation: Aziz ikki hafta kasal bo'ldi, shuning uchun o'qishdan **ortda qoldi**.

sentences.text: Walk a bit slower — I can't **keep up**!
sentences.translation: Biroz sekinroq yuring — **yetib ololmayapman**!

sentences.text: You go first; I'll **catch up with** you at the bus stop.
sentences.translation: Sen oldinroq boraver, men seni bekatda **quvib yetaman**.

sentences.text: It **kept on** raining all weekend, so we stayed at home.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari bo'yi yomg'ir **yog'averdi**, shuning uchun uyda qoldik.

sentences.text: Emma started a cooking course, but she **dropped out** after a month.
sentences.translation: Emma pazandachilik kursini boshladi, lekin bir oydan keyin **tashlab ketdi**.

sentences.text: After a short break, the teacher **went on** with the lesson.
sentences.translation: Qisqa tanaffusdan keyin o'qituvchi darsni **davom ettirdi**.

examples.title: Problems: **run out of**, **go off**, **turn up**
examples.description: Muammo va kutilmagan voqealar: run out of, go off (signal; ovqat), go out (chiroq), fall over, turn up, show up, break up, come up.

sentences.text: We've **run out of** bread — can you buy some on your way home?
sentences.translation: Nonimiz **tugab qoldi** — uyga kelayotib olib kelolasanmi?

sentences.text: The milk has **gone off** — it smells terrible.
sentences.translation: Sut **aynib qolibdi** — hidi dahshat.

sentences.text: My alarm didn't **go off**, so I was late for work.
sentences.translation: Budilnigim **chalinmadi**, shuning uchun ishga kechikdim.

sentences.text: Suddenly all the lights **went out**, and the room was dark.
sentences.translation: To'satdan barcha chiroqlar **o'chdi** va xona qorong'i bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Grandpa slipped on the ice and **fell over**, but he wasn't hurt.
sentences.translation: Bobom muzda sirpanib **yiqilib tushdi**, lekin jarohat olmadi.

sentences.text: We invited twenty people, but only eight **turned up**.
sentences.translation: Yigirma kishini taklif qildik, lekin faqat sakkiztasi **keldi**.

sentences.text: Tom **showed up** at the party an hour late, without a present.
sentences.translation: Tom ziyofatga bir soat kech, sovg'asiz **kelib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Hurry, we're **running out of** time!
sentences.translation: Shoshiling, vaqtimiz **tugayapti**!

sentences.text: After five years together, Sarah and James **broke up**.
sentences.translation: Besh yil birga bo'lgandan keyin Sara va Jeyms **ajrashishdi**.

sentences.text: Something **came up** at work, so I can't come tonight.
sentences.translation: Ishda bir gap **chiqib qoldi**, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun kela olmayman.

examples.title: People and feelings: **get on with**, **calm down**
examples.description: Odamlar va his-tuyg'ular: get on with, fall out with, make up, calm down, cheer up, grow up, look forward to.

sentences.text: Do you **get on with** your new colleagues?
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasblaringiz bilan **chiqisha olyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **fell out with** her best friend over a silly joke.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bir bema'ni hazil tufayli eng yaqin dugonasi bilan **urishib qoldi**.

sentences.text: **Calm down** — shouting won't help.
sentences.translation: **Tinchlaning** — baqirish yordam bermaydi.

sentences.text: **Cheer up**! It's only one bad mark.
sentences.translation: **Boshingizni ko'taring**! Bor-yo'g'i bitta yomon baho-ku.

sentences.text: Where did you **grow up**? In Andijan or in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Qayerda **o'sgansiz**? Andijondami yoki Toshkentda?

sentences.text: The children **grew up** so fast — Madina is already at university!
sentences.translation: Bolalar juda tez **katta bo'lib ketishdi** — Madina allaqachon universitetda!

sentences.text: After the argument, the two brothers **made up** and shook hands.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin ikki aka-uka **yarashib**, qo'l berib ko'rishdi.

sentences.text: James is very easy-going; he **gets on** well with everybody.
sentences.translation: Jeyms juda ochiqko'ngil; u hamma bilan yaxshi **chiqishadi**.

sentences.text: I'm really **looking forward to** seeing you in London!
sentences.translation: Londonda siz bilan ko'rishishni **intiqlik bilan kutyapman**!

sentences.text: When Aziz heard the news, he **cheered up** immediately.
sentences.translation: Yangilikni eshitib, Aziz darhol **xursand bo'lib ketdi**.

examples.title: Commands: **Come in!**, **Look out!**, **Hold on!**
examples.description: Frazali fe'llar buyruq gapda — qisqa iltimos, ogohlantirish va dalda: come in, hurry up, look out, watch out, hold on, hang on, come on, slow down, speak up.

sentences.text: **Come in** and take off your shoes, please.
sentences.translation: **Kiring**, poyabzalingizni yeching, iltimos.

sentences.text: **Hurry up**, the film starts in ten minutes!
sentences.translation: **Tezroq bo'l**, film o'n daqiqadan keyin boshlanadi!

sentences.text: **Look out**, the floor in the corridor is still wet!
sentences.translation: **Ehtiyot bo'ling**, yo'lakdagi pol hali ho'l!

sentences.text: **Hold on** a minute — I'll check if Mr Karimov is in his office.
sentences.translation: **Bir daqiqa kutib turing** — janob Karimov xonasidami, tekshirib ko'raman.

sentences.text: **Watch out** for the step when you go down to the basement.
sentences.translation: Yerto'laga tushayotganda zinaga **ehtiyot bo'ling**.

sentences.text: **Come on**, Bekzod, you can do it!
sentences.translation: **Qani**, Bekzod, sen uddalaysan!

sentences.text: Please **go away** and leave me alone — I'm working.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **keting**, meni tinch qo'ying — ishlayapman.

sentences.text: **Slow down**! You're driving too fast for this road.
sentences.translation: **Sekinroq**! Bu yo'l uchun juda tez haydayapsiz.

sentences.text: **Speak up**, Jasur — the people in the last row are missing everything.
sentences.translation: **Balandroq gapir**, Jasur — oxirgi qatordagilar hech narsani eshitmayapti.

sentences.text: **Hang on**, I think I've left my keys in the car.
sentences.translation: **To'xta**, kalitlarimni mashinada qoldirdim shekilli.

examples.title: Three-part verbs: **run out of**, **put up with**
examples.description: Uch qismli frazali fe'llar: fe'l + kichik so'z + predlog (run out of, get on with, look forward to, catch up with, keep up with, come up with, put up with). Predlogdan keyin ot, olmosh yoki `-ing`.

sentences.text: The printer has **run out of** paper again.
sentences.translation: Printerda yana qog'oz **tugab qoldi**.

sentences.text: I don't **get on with** my neighbour — he's always complaining.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnim bilan **chiqisha olmayman** — u doim noliydi.

sentences.text: We're all **looking forward to** the summer holidays.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz yozgi ta'tilni **intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Go ahead, I'll **catch up with** you later.
sentences.translation: Siz boravering, men keyinroq sizga **yetib olaman**.

sentences.text: It's hard to **keep up with** all the new technology.
sentences.translation: Barcha yangi texnologiyalardan **orqada qolmaslik** qiyin.

sentences.text: Who **came up with** the idea of a picnic by the river?
sentences.translation: Daryo bo'yida piknik qilish g'oyasini kim **o'ylab topdi**?

sentences.text: How do you **put up with** all that noise from the street?
sentences.translation: Ko'chadan keladigan shuncha shovqinga qanday **chidaysiz**?

sentences.text: In crowded markets, **watch out for** pickpockets.
sentences.translation: Gavjum bozorlarda cho'ntakkesarlardan **ehtiyot bo'ling**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **caught up on** her sleep at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza dam olish kunlari **to'yib uxlab oldi**.

sentences.text: Tom **went back to** sleep after the phone call.
sentences.translation: Telefon qo'ng'irog'idan keyin Tom yana **uyquga ketdi**.

examples.title: Mixed: Bekzod's very bad day
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta kun haqidagi hikoya — turli mavzudagi frazali fe'llar o'tgan zamonda (fe'l qismi o'zgaradi, kichik so'z o'zgarmaydi).

sentences.text: Bekzod **woke up** late, **got up** quickly and **set off** without breakfast.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kech **uyg'ondi**, tezda **turdi** va nonushtasiz **yo'lga chiqdi**.

sentences.text: On the motorway his car **broke down**, so he **got out** and called a taxi.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistralda mashinasi **buzilib qoldi**, u **tushib**, taksi chaqirdi.

sentences.text: The meeting had already started when he finally **turned up**.
sentences.translation: U nihoyat **yetib kelganda**, yig'ilish allaqachon boshlangan edi.

sentences.text: His boss smiled and told him to **sit down** and **calm down**.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'i jilmayib, unga **o'tirib**, **tinchlanishni** aytdi.

sentences.text: In the afternoon the office printer **ran out of** ink.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin ofis printerida siyoh **tugab qoldi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't **give up**; he **carried on** working until seven.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **taslim bo'lmadi**; soat yettigacha ishlashda **davom etdi**.

sentences.text: On his way home he **got on** the wrong bus and had to **get off** in the suburbs.
sentences.translation: Uyga ketayotib noto'g'ri avtobusga **chiqib qoldi** va shahar chekkasida **tushishga** majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: When he finally **got back** home, the lights **went out** — a power cut!
sentences.translation: Nihoyat uyga **qaytib kelganda**, chiroqlar **o'chib qoldi** — elektr uzildi!

sentences.text: His wife **cheered** him **up** with a cup of tea and some cake.
sentences.translation: Rafiqasi bir piyola choy va tort bilan uning **ko'nglini ko'tardi**.

sentences.text: Tomorrow, he says, he'll **stay in** and won't **go out** at all.
sentences.translation: Ertaga, deydi u, uyda **qoladi** va umuman **ko'chaga chiqmaydi**.
